title: From-scratch diagnostic for CONFOUND_ALERT_GENERALIZED: does a model TRAINED on the recall task at long context show p2d arm4's gradual far-field decline, or flat recall to its architectural limit?
one_line: p2d arm4 (mistral v0.1, window disabled) declined gradually at far strata; p2e showed v0.2 (different RoPE base, extended-context training) declines at the same strata too -- so the decline may be a general property of pretrained checkpoints at extreme distance rather than evidence about windows. p2f trains TWO from-scratch stablegla models at block_size 8704 on the recall task (needle depths uniform over absolute distances) and scores the frozen p2d/p2e strata: arm_nowindow (full causal reach -- THE diagnostic) and arm_w4096 (window 4096 -- positive control, predicted sharp step, replicating the law in-distribution at this scale).

instrument.harness: ~/archlab-s05 from-scratch harness (p1b/p1c/p1d lineage), copy-extended into ~/archlab-p2f (s05 never edited in place; verbatim copies: models.py, train.py, data.py, probes.py; new code: data_p2f.py, gen_pools_p2f.py, probes_gen_p2f.py, eval_p2f.py, runner_p2f.py, aggregate_p2f.py, verify_p2f.py, autorun.sh)
instrument.model: stablegla 12-layer, d=768, heads=12, hidden=2048, vocab 32000 (Llama-2 tokenizer ids), ~110M params, block_size 8704 -- the bench_longctx_8704-verified V100 envelope (batch=2, peak 20.55GB, ~7.3s/step, chunked_causal + per-chunk gradient checkpointing, TRAIN_CHUNK=256). stablegla chosen per DESIGN-NOTE step-2 finding: transformer at this scale OOMs on V100 without an fp16/efficient-attention override; stablegla runs unmodified.
instrument.training_recipe: p1c recipe otherwise: AdamW lr 3e-4 betas (0.9,0.95) wd 0.1, 2% linear warmup + cosine to 0.1x, grad-clip 1.0, bf16 autocast, 10% needle + 10% kv training mix. Deviations forced by scale, all listed in deviations_from_p1c.

needle_training_mix.template: p2c/p2d/p2e 'secret code' instrument verbatim (KEYS/VALUES lists), answer ' NN' (3 tokens) appended at row end so LM loss teaches the retrieval format. Training format == eval format by design: a from-scratch model only learns formats it is shown (p1b GATE_NOT_MET lesson).
needle_training_mix.depth_distribution: UNIFORM over absolute distances d in [64, 8300] (value token -> query position). Because 8300 > the largest eval stratum 7792 (with margin), the training depth distribution CANNOT explain a far-field decline at or below 7792 -- any decline observed is a property of the trained model, not of under-sampled training depths.
needle_training_mix.filler: train.bin (training split); eval battery filler is val.bin (held-out) only

instrument.kv_training_mix: p1c's pool reused byte-identical (~/archlab-s05/data/train_kv.npy via symlink, 40000x1024, salt 20260731, sha256 f66ce443ea1e5bde37f6d5f292567d04bc1e2adca48805d0c28580ad7ad2e2c4); rows placed at container start, zero-padded, same containment convention as s05
deviations_from_p1c: block_size 8704 (was 1024) -- the point of the campaign; batch 2 (was 16), memory-bound on V100 per bench_longctx_8704

PER-ROW BERNOULLI mixing (p=0.10 needle, p=0.10 kv) instead of data.py's k=int(round(frac*batch)) count rule: at batch=2 the count rule floors to 0 and would silently never mix. Bernoulli preserves the intended 10% expectation at any batch size (data_p2f.py)

needle template is the p2c/p2d/p2e secret-code instrument (digit values, digit-boundary scoring), not s05's 'By the way' word-answer template -- so the frozen eval battery and training format match the deployed-checkpoint campaigns' instrument
staged token budget 350M (see staged_budget), not p1c's 1.2e9
checkpoints every 1000 steps; monitoring probes every 2000 steps (subset, no gate authority)

staged_budget.rationale: Full p1c budget (1.2e9 tokens) at 7.3s/step would take ~6 days on V100 -- too long. p1b's record shows needle-format recall emerges by ~5% of a 1.2e9 budget when the format is supervised; 350M is ~6x that emergence point.
staged_budget.interpretation_fixed_in_advance: If G0_capability has not been met at the 350M-token endpoint, the diagnostic is INCONCLUSIVE-UNDERTRAINED for that arm -- NOT a confirmation of decline -- and a continuation decision goes to the operator/Hani. No mid-run stopping on interim probe readings; monitoring probes have no gate authority.

arms.role: THE diagnostic: full causal reach within the 8704 block, trained on the recall task with uniform absolute needle depths. If it holds far-field recall, arm4/p2e's decline is a pretrained-checkpoint property; if it declines the same way, the decline generalizes to from-scratch training.

Positive control at the same scale: sliding window W=4096 (models.py S05_WINDOW mask), predicted sharp step at the boundary -- replicates the law in-distribution and validates instrument+scale. Same strata as arm_nowindow for direct comparison.

seed_provenance: 2103 and 2104, fresh, next free in Lab 2's 21xx S05 block per p1e/campaign.json ('2100 consumed by p1a/p1b/p1c/p1d; p1e used 2101/2102; next free is 2103+'). Verified unused by grep across ~/archlab-operator and all campaign.json files 2026-08-02.
window_enforcement: models.py reads S05_WINDOW at import time -- p1e G2's documented silent-failure hazard. Hardening: runner_p2f.py and eval_p2f.py BOTH (1) assert models.WINDOW == the arm's expected window from an independent env var, and (2) take a structural readout of the actual mask arithmetic (_causal_chunk_body with zeroed content/bias over v=arange recovers the earliest attendable position) and assert max_attendable_distance == block-1 (nowindow) / W-1 (w4096). Recorded in every result and eval file.

frozen_eval_battery.strata_provenance: EXACTLY p2d arm4 / p2e's 24 strata (re-derived from p2e's own strata_for(4096, 8192) by the operator's 06:10Z read-only prep, recorded in DESIGN-NOTE.md) -- direct per-distance comparability with the already-collected pretrained-checkpoint curves
frozen_eval_battery.controls: 24 length-matched no-needle negative controls per stratum at ALL 24 strata (superset of the far-strata minimum), scored identically against the value the paired needle would have carried; matched-regime chance rate p_chance measured from them
frozen_eval_battery.probe_shape: FIXED-LENGTH probes, all 8698 tokens (block 8704 minus 6 generation slots), query ending at position 8697, needle position varying: for a fixed-block from-scratch model this makes needle DISTANCE the only variable across strata (not sequence length, not query position), and matches the training-row geometry. Deviation from p2e's variable-length build_prompt, recorded here before launch.
frozen_eval_battery.distance_anchor: first tail token (value marker) -> query position, p2c FIX 1 convention
frozen_eval_battery.scoring: strict digit-boundary exact match, token-level equivalent of p2e's gen.strip().startswith(value)+non-digit-boundary: greedy continuation must be [optional 29871 marker] d1 d2 then a non-digit token. Fast path = teacher-forced argmax equivalence (exact for greedy decoding); probes whose first greedy token is d1 (marker-less path) are re-scored by true free-run decode. Scorer selftest (fast-vs-free on sampled probes) passed 32/32 (nowindow) and 8/8 (w4096) pre-launch with 0 mismatches.
frozen_eval_battery.no_BOS: the s05 training regime has no BOS convention; probes are raw Llama-2 token ids

frozen_eval_battery.determinism_verified: regenerated twice from the sealed salt, byte-identical; saved battery matches regeneration byte-for-byte (verify_p2f.py, pre-launch)
frozen_eval_battery.gate_authority: scored ONLY at the trained endpoint by eval_p2f.py (full 48 reps + controls). Checkpoint-time monitoring uses a 12-rep needle-only subset every 2000 steps, appended to probe_progress.log, and has NO gate authority.

preregistered_gates.G0_capability: arm recall >= 0.90 at every stratum <= 1611 (64, 101, 161, 255, 404, 641, 1016, 1611), else INCONCLUSIVE-UNDERTRAINED for that arm (continuation decision to operator/Hani; NOT a confirmation of decline).
preregistered_gates.GS_shape_nowindow: THE question, arm_nowindow only, over strata 4048->7792 (15 strata): FLAT (all >= 0.90) => arm4's decline is a pretrained-checkpoint property, NOT fundamental; the p2d/p2e suspension of LAW_ARITHMETIC_TRANSFERS is resolvable in the law's favor with the residual attributed to checkpoint long-context capability. DECLINING (monotone-ish decline mirroring arm4's shape: Spearman rho < -0.7 over the 15 strata AND final stratum 7792 recall < 0.5) => the decline generalizes to from-scratch training; the law's far-field account needs an explicit capability-decay term; the suspension stands. MIXED (anything else) => report shape, no claim.
preregistered_gates.GW_window_control: arm_w4096: recall >= 0.90 at all strata <= 4048 AND recall <= p_chance_measured_matched_regime + 0.05 at all strata >= 4144 => instrument + scale validated (sharp step at this block size). If GW FAILS the whole campaign is INSTRUMENT-SUSPECT and no GS claim is made -- said so explicitly in the decision.
preregistered_gates.precedence: GW first (instrument validity), then G0 on arm_nowindow, then GS. decision.json is produced mechanically by aggregate_p2f.py from these definitions; no amendments after launch. Instrument crash-robustness fixes that do not touch scoring or gates are permitted and logged, per p2c/p2d/p2e precedent.

limitations_noted_before_launch: stablegla carries an explicit multi-timescale decay prior (init half-lives 8-256 tokens, adaptable ~0.6-1.65x by the trained gate). A DECLINING result therefore establishes that the decline generalizes to THIS from-scratch architecture trained on the task; architecture-specific decay is a candidate mechanism that the writeup must name as an alternative attribution (p1d showed the same arch reaches recall ~1.0 at d~1000, so the prior is adaptable at least that far). A FLAT result is unambiguous in the other direction.
One seed per arm; same n=1-per-cell caveat p1d itself carried.
350M-token staged budget: an UNDERTRAINED verdict is pre-registered as inconclusive, never as evidence of decline.
